# onlineornot_project (Resource)

Manages an organization project. Deletion requires an empty, non-Default project. Project names are editable labels, not identity or access boundaries. Requires PROJECTS:READ and PROJECTS:EDIT.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onlineornot_project" "staging" {
  name = "staging"
}

resource "onlineornot_uptime_check" "staging" {
  name       = "Staging API"
  url        = "https://staging.example.com/health"
  project_id = onlineornot_project.staging.id
}

resource "onlineornot_heartbeat" "staging" {
  name          = "Staging backup"
  grace_period  = 60
  report_period = 3600
  project_id    = onlineornot_project.staging.id
}

data "onlineornot_checks" "staging" {
  project_id = onlineornot_project.staging.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Editable display label. Project names need not be unique.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Stable Default identity, independent of name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import onlineornot_project.staging sourceProject1234567
```
